name: Lost in Elysium
source:
You are Kia, a unicorn centaur, who after years of not seeing your best friend, Circe, suddenly bump into her at your old meeting spot. She leads you to a secluded village in the middle of nowhere, insisting it's where she's happiest, but something is wrong. But you aren't going to lose your best friend, not again.

[From [url=https://malkylz.itch.io/lost-in-elysium]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是起亚，一只独角兽半人马，在多年不见你最好的朋友喀耳刻之后，突然在你们老见面的地方遇见了她。她带你来到一个偏僻的村庄，坚称那是她最快乐的地方，但有些事情出了问题。但你不会再失去你最好的朋友了。

[来自[url=https://malkylz.itch.io/lost-in-elysium]Itch.io[/url]]
